name: Exp_The_20s_v020
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom indicator 'The_20s_v020', which identifies momentum-based entry points using a configurable trigger level and ratio. It opens buy/sell positions when the indicator produces non-empty values on the signal bar and manages exits by searching historical bars for the last opposing signal. Position sizing supports multiple margin modes including fixed lot, balance-based, and free margin-based allocation.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义指标'The_20s_v020'的信号进行交易，该指标通过可配置的触发水平和比率识别动量入场点。当指标在信号K线上产生非空值时开仓做多或做空，并通过回溯历史K线寻找最后一个反向信号来管理出场。仓位管理支持固定手数、基于余额和基于可用保证金等多种资金管理模式。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于自定义指标The_20s_v020产生的动量信号进行交易，该指标通过触发水平(Level)和比率(Ratio)参数识别价格动量变化。入场条件为：当指标上轨缓冲区(UpValue)在指定信号K线上产生非零且非空值时触发买入信号，当下轨缓冲区(DnValue)产生非零且非空值时触发卖出信号。出场条件采用反向信号平仓机制——如果当前K线没有直接的反向信号，EA会回溯历史K线搜索最后一个反向信号来决定是否平仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数(LOT)、基于余额(BALANCE)、基于可用保证金(FREEMARGIN)、基于亏损占比的余额模式(LOSSBALANCE)和基于亏损占比的可用保证金模式(LOSSFREEMARGIN)。资金管理通过MM参数控制投入比例，StopLoss和TakeProfit分别设置止损和止盈点数。EA还包含权限控制开关，可独立启用/禁用买卖开仓和平仓操作，支持两种计算算法(MODE_1和MODE_2)以及信号方向反转(Direct参数)。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on momentum signals generated by the custom indicator The_20s_v020, which identifies price momentum shifts using a configurable trigger level (Level) and ratio (Ratio). Entry conditions are triggered when the indicator's upper buffer (UpValue) produces a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE on the designated signal bar for buy signals, and similarly the lower buffer (DnValue) for sell signals. Exit conditions use a reverse-signal closing mechanism — if no direct reverse signal appears on the current bar, the EA searches backward through historical bars to find the last opposing signal to determine whether to close positions. Position sizing supports five modes: fixed lot (LOT), balance-based (BALANCE), free margin-based (FREEMARGIN), loss-share from balance (LOSSBALANCE), and loss-share from free margin (LOSSFREEMARGIN). Money management is controlled via the MM parameter which sets the deposit share per deal, while StopLoss and TakeProfit define the exit points in points. The EA also features permission switches for independently enabling/disabling buy/sell open and close operations, supports two calculation algorithms (MODE_1 and MODE_2), and allows signal direction inversion via the Direct parameter.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 每笔交易投入的存款比例

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数计算方法（固定手数/余额/可用保证金等）
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation method (fixed lots/balance/free margin etc.)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线编号

pros: 支持多种资金管理模式，灵活适应不同风险偏好
买卖开仓和平仓权限可独立控制，便于精细化管理策略行为
使用新K线检测(IsNewBar)机制避免同一K线内重复交易
止损止盈均可配置，具备基本风险控制框架
支持信号方向反转参数，方便策略验证和优化
pros_en: Supports multiple margin/lot calculation modes for flexible risk management adaptation
Independent permission switches for buy/sell open and close operations enable fine-grained strategy control
Uses new bar detection (IsNewBar) to prevent repeated trading within the same bar
Configurable stop loss and take profit provide a basic risk control framework
Signal direction inversion parameter facilitates strategy testing and optimization
cons: 依赖自定义指标The_20s_v020的逻辑不透明，策略核心黑盒化，难以验证和审计
历史K线回溯搜索反向信号的平仓逻辑效率低且可能不准确，回溯范围无上限
没有点差过滤、交易时间过滤或市场条件过滤，可能在不利条件下频繁交易
止损1000点和止盈2000点的默认值过大，对大多数品种不实用
缺少持仓检查和重复开仓防护，可能在已有同向持仓时重复开仓
cons_en: Relies on custom indicator The_20s_v020 whose logic is opaque — the strategy core is a black box, hard to verify or audit
The reverse-signal search logic for closing positions is inefficient and potentially inaccurate, with no upper bound on historical bar lookback
No spread filter, trading session filter, or market condition filter — may trade frequently under unfavorable conditions
Default StopLoss of 1000 points and TakeProfit of 2000 points are excessively large for most instruments
Lacks position check and duplicate opening prevention — may open duplicate positions in the same direction
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同向重复开仓，并在开仓前验证当前无同向持仓
为反向信号搜索设置最大回溯K线数量上限，避免无限循环和性能问题
增加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，防止在不利的交易条件下开仓
improvements_en: Add position check logic to prevent duplicate opening in the same direction and verify no existing position before entry
Set a maximum lookback bar limit for the reverse signal search to prevent infinite loops and performance issues
Add spread filter and trading session filter to prevent opening positions under unfavorable trading conditions

risk_points: 无持仓检查可能导致同方向重复开仓，放大风险敞口
止损止盈默认值过大（1000/2000点），若用户未调整可能造成巨额亏损
历史K线无上限回溯搜索可能在极端情况下消耗大量计算资源
risk_points_en: No position check may lead to duplicate openings in the same direction, amplifying risk exposure
Default SL/TP values are extremely large (1000/2000 points) — failure to adjust may cause massive losses
Unbounded historical bar lookback search may consume excessive computational resources in extreme cases
